ds4-q2.note: antirez/deepseek-v4.1-flash-gguf @ dd8a266f Q2: IQ2_XXS routed gate/up, Q2_K routed down, Q8 attention/shared/output; 151.77 GiB main weights plus 188.83 GiB native FP8 Engram tables that ds4 reads from disk. The full-file sha256 is pinned in configs/pins/ds41f-weights.json and was verified independently on 2026-09-25 (weights/deepseek-v4.1-flash/manifest.json). The switch checks the sampled identity (first MiB sha256, size, device, inode) because hashing 365.7 GB on every switch is not practical.
